app_info.subtitle: Manage WordPress sites
app_info.description: WordPress.com helps users find their sites, manage content, update site structure, configure collaborators, plugins, domains, and DNS, and start AI-assisted site builds through ChatGPT.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists sites accessible to the authenticated user and does not change site or account data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content, send messages, or change public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only finds sites that opted in to AI Agent Access and returns matching site metadata.
justifications.open_world_justification: May query across WordPress.com and Jetpack-connected sites rather than only a single local workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Can add or remove DNS records for a custom domain, so it modifies domain configuration.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes are limited to domain configuration managed inside the user's WordPress.com account.
justifications.destructive_justification: Can remove or overwrite DNS records, which can break site, mail, or verification routing.

justifications.read_only_justification: Can restore WordPress.com default DNS records, so it modifies domain configuration.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes are limited to domain configuration managed inside the user's WordPress.com account.
justifications.destructive_justification: Can overwrite existing DNS records with defaults, which can disrupt current domain behavior.

justifications.read_only_justification: Can replace the nameservers for a custom domain, so it modifies domain configuration.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes are limited to domain configuration managed inside the user's WordPress.com account.
justifications.destructive_justification: Can redirect domain authority to different nameservers, which can make site or email records stop resolving.

justifications.read_only_justification: Can configure DNS records for an external mail provider, so it modifies domain configuration.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes are limited to domain configuration managed inside the user's WordPress.com account.
justifications.destructive_justification: Can change mail routing records, which can disrupt email delivery for the domain.

justifications.read_only_justification: Can invite users, change roles, resend invites, cancel invites, or remove access, so it modifies collaboration state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Can send invitations and affect access for people outside the current ChatGPT session.
justifications.destructive_justification: Can remove collaborator access or change roles, which can revoke or reduce permissions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Can install, activate, deactivate, update, and uninstall plugins, so it modifies site state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Plugin lifecycle changes can affect a live WordPress.com site visible to visitors.
justifications.destructive_justification: Can deactivate or uninstall plugins, which can remove functionality or break site behavior.

justifications.read_only_justification: Can create, edit, publish, organize, and moderate site content, so it modifies content state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Can publish or change posts, pages, media, comments, categories, tags, and patterns on live sites.
justifications.destructive_justification: Can delete or overwrite content and taxonomy data through write operations.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves theme, preset, style, and block availability context for a site.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content, send messages, or change public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Can modify templates, template parts, navigation menus, global styles, and themes, so it changes site structure.
justifications.open_world_justification: Can change site-wide structure and styling that live site visitors may see.
justifications.destructive_justification: Can overwrite templates, navigation, global styles, or theme state in ways that affect the whole site.

justifications.read_only_justification: Supports account read and write operations for profile, notifications, subscriptions, connections, domains, and security.
justifications.open_world_justification: Operations are scoped to the authenticated user's WordPress.com account rather than publishing public content or messages.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not advertise delete, revoke, or irreversible account actions in the tool description.

justifications.read_only_justification: Supports read and write operations for a WordPress.com site, including settings, plugins, users, and activity data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Operations are scoped to the selected WordPress.com site rather than arbitrary external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not advertise delete, uninstall, revoke, or irreversible site actions in the facade description.

justifications.read_only_justification: Can start an AI site-building workflow from a confirmed specification, so it changes site state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Can create or change a WordPress.com site that may become visible on the internet.
justifications.destructive_justification: Starts a build workflow and does not directly delete or overwrite an existing selected resource.

justifications.read_only_justification: Kicks off an asynchronous AI site build after confirmation, so it changes site-building state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Can create or change a WordPress.com site build that may become visible on the internet.
justifications.destructive_justification: Starts a build workflow and does not directly delete or overwrite an existing selected resource.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only checks the progress of an existing AI site build session.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content, send messages, or change public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only checks whether the current authenticated user is an Automattician.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content, send messages, or change public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Can approve MCP feedback in addition to fetching pending feedback, so it modifies feedback state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Can change submitted feedback workflow state outside the current chat session.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete feedback or perform irreversible destructive actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Submits feature requests, bug reports, or general feedback, so it creates feedback records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Sends feedback to the WordPress.com MCP feedback system outside the current chat session.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only answers questions using Jetpack Search and voice guidelines without changing the blog.
justifications.open_world_justification: May query a blog through Jetpack Search rather than only local ChatGPT context.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

test_cases.description: Discover the user's WordPress.com sites before a site-scoped action.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the WordPress.com sites I can manage.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns accessible sites with enough identifying information for the user to choose a site.

test_cases.description: Review design context before drafting or editing site content.
test_cases.user_prompt: Before updating my homepage, inspect the active theme styles and available design tokens.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns active theme and design context that can guide later content or layout edits.

test_cases.description: Create or edit site content after site selection and user confirmation for writes.
test_cases.user_prompt: Update the About page on my selected site to mention weekend workshops.
test_cases.expected_output: Inspects or resolves the target content, performs the confirmed update, and summarizes the changed page.

test_cases.description: Configure DNS records for a custom domain with safety-sensitive write handling.
test_cases.user_prompt: Add the Google Workspace TXT verification record for example.com.
test_cases.expected_output: Checks the domain context, applies the confirmed DNS change, and reports the record type and domain affected.

test_cases.description: Start an AI-assisted site build only after the user confirms the site specification.
test_cases.user_prompt: Build me a WordPress.com site for a neighborhood bakery with a warm homepage, menu, and contact section.
test_cases.expected_output: Collects or confirms the build specification, starts the build, and reports progress or completion status.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated calendar requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because calendar lookup is outside the supported WordPress.com workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not complete commerce or purchase flows in ChatGPT.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Buy a new WordPress.com plan and domain for my site.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not complete a purchase or checkout flow and should explain that purchases are unsupported in this surface.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for generic WordPress coding help that does not need the user's WordPress.com account.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Explain how to write a WordPress shortcode in PHP.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the request can be answered without account or site tools.
